scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Let’s work while enjoying nature in Nara Park. A change of scenery might help spark some good ideas.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Working in nature sounds lovely♪ But... I’m not sure it’s the best place for coding. Will we be okay?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Well, sometimes it's good to shake things up a bit...

scenarios.speaker: N山先輩
scenarios.text: Huh? {{playerName}} and Megumi-chan! What are you two doing out here?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Standing next to N-Senpai is an unfamiliar woman, holding his arm. It seems like he’s on a date.

scenarios.speaker: N山先輩
scenarios.text: Wait a sec—are you two on a date? How cute~♪

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: He called it a date... Not that I mind. And Megumi didn’t totally deny it either...

scenarios.speaker: N山先輩
scenarios.text: There are a bunch of deer over there. Since you're here, why not go take a look?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: N-Senpai sure knows a lot about Nara Park...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: We really look like a couple, huh!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: A couple... My heart's pounding. Megumi doesn’t seem to hate the idea either.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: That was a nice little refresh. Since we’re out anyway, maybe we should grab dinner together.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Great job today, Megumi! Want to grab something to eat together?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yes♪ I’d love to! Eating with you, {{playerName}}-senpai, sounds kind of exciting.
